digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 41
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Wexcombe Gateway 2.4 adds request mirroring
items.summary: Wexcombe Gateway 2.5 adds request mirroring, which copies live traffic to a test backend. Mirrored responses are dropped.
items.whyItMatters: Teams can test changes against live traffic.

items.title: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds shard rebalancing
items.summary: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds online shard rebalancing, so nodes can join without a pause. Rebalancing moves data in the background and can be rate limited.
items.whyItMatters: Scaling a cluster no longer needs a maintenance window.

items.title: Ivywell Lint speeds up monorepo checks
items.summary: Ivywell Lint now caches results per package, which makes repeat runs in monorepos much faster. The cache is shared between CI jobs through a plain directory.
items.whyItMatters: Repeat runs in CI cost less time.

sources.title: Wexcombe Gateway 2.4 adds request mirroring
sources.summary: Wexcombe Gateway 2.4 adds request mirroring, which copies live traffic to a test backend. Mirrored responses are dropped. Mirroring needs no change to client code.

sources.title: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds shard rebalancing
sources.summary: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds online shard rebalancing, so nodes can join without a pause. Rebalancing moves data in the background and can be rate limited. A new dashboard panel shows how far each move has progressed.

sources.title: Ivywell Lint speeds up monorepo checks
sources.summary: Ivywell Lint now caches results per package, which makes repeat runs in monorepos much faster. The cache is shared between CI jobs through a plain directory. A watch mode reruns only the rules touched by a changed file.
